parts.name: main body

physics.Basic_description: Large matte black bulbous housing forming the central body of the blower.
physics.Functional_description: Encloses the fan mechanism and directs airflow from intake to outlet.
physics.Grasped_description: Grasp the main spherical body firmly with a parallel jaw gripper to stabilize the object.
physics.reason: Injection molded plastic housing enclosing air and internal components.

parts.description: Large matte black bulbous housing forming the central body of the blower.
parts.function: Encloses the fan mechanism and directs airflow from intake to outlet.

parts.name: outlet socket

physics.Basic_description: Short black cylindrical connector protruding from the main body towards the nozzle.
physics.Functional_description: Connects the main housing to the flexible nozzle tube.
physics.Grasped_description: Too small and integral to grasp independently; avoid grasping here.
physics.reason: Thin-walled plastic pipe section for air passage.

parts.description: Short black cylindrical connector protruding from the main body towards the nozzle.
parts.function: Connects the main housing to the flexible nozzle tube.

parts.name: intake grille

physics.Basic_description: Cylindrical cap on top with a grid of square perforations, dark grey/black.
physics.Functional_description: Allows air intake while preventing large debris from entering the fan.
physics.Grasped_description: Fragile perforated structure; do not grasp directly to avoid damage.
physics.reason: Perforated shell structure covering the intake area.

parts.description: Cylindrical cap on top with a grid of square perforations, dark grey/black.
parts.function: Allows air intake while preventing large debris from entering the fan.

parts.name: intake foam

physics.Basic_description: Yellowish porous material visible inside the intake grille area.
physics.Functional_description: Filters fine dust particles from the incoming air.
physics.Grasped_description: Internal component, not accessible for grasping.
physics.reason: Porous foam material is effectively solid for mass estimation despite air pockets.

parts.description: Yellowish porous material visible inside the intake grille area.
parts.function: Filters fine dust particles from the incoming air.

parts.name: housing foot

physics.Basic_description: Small protrusion at the bottom of the main housing near the crank shaft.
physics.Functional_description: Provides structural support or mounting point for the crank assembly.
physics.reason: Small structural rib/foot likely solid plastic.

parts.description: Small protrusion at the bottom of the main housing near the crank shaft.
parts.function: Provides structural support or mounting point for the crank assembly.

parts.name: metal tube

physics.Basic_description: Grey, ribbed, flexible corrugated tube extending from the outlet.
physics.Functional_description: Directs the airflow to the target; flexibility allows aiming.
physics.Grasped_description: Grasp the ribbed section gently to aim the nozzle without kinking.
physics.reason: Flexible tubing is inherently hollow to pass air.

parts.description: Grey, ribbed, flexible corrugated tube extending from the outlet.
parts.function: Directs the airflow to the target; flexibility allows aiming.

parts.name: base sleeve

physics.Basic_description: Green-colored ring segment connecting the nozzle to the body in the mask (likely black plastic in reality).
physics.Functional_description: Secures the flexible tube to the rigid outlet socket.
physics.Grasped_description: Small connection point, not suitable for grasping.
physics.reason: Connector sleeve is a thin-walled cylinder.

parts.description: Green-colored ring segment connecting the nozzle to the body in the mask (likely black plastic in reality).
parts.function: Secures the flexible tube to the rigid outlet socket.

parts.name: retaining ring

physics.Basic_description: Small ring detail at the base of the nozzle tube.
physics.Functional_description: Retains the tube or provides a seal.
physics.reason: Small ring likely solid or thick-walled relative to size.

parts.description: Small ring detail at the base of the nozzle tube.
parts.function: Retains the tube or provides a seal.

parts.name: adjustment rib

physics.Basic_description: The ribbed texture along the length of the grey nozzle tube.
physics.Functional_description: Provides flexibility and grip for bending the nozzle.
physics.Grasped_description: Part of the graspable tube surface.
physics.reason: Integral part of the hollow flexible tube.

parts.description: The ribbed texture along the length of the grey nozzle tube.
parts.function: Provides flexibility and grip for bending the nozzle.

parts.name: crank hub

physics.Basic_description: Central yellow/green point where the crank arm attaches to the shaft.
physics.Functional_description: Transfers torque from the arm to the drive shaft.
physics.reason: Small load-bearing hub likely solid plastic.

parts.description: Central yellow/green point where the crank arm attaches to the shaft.
parts.function: Transfers torque from the arm to the drive shaft.

parts.name: crank arm

physics.Basic_description: Thin teal-colored rod extending downwards from the housing.
physics.Functional_description: Lever arm for the user to rotate the internal fan.
physics.Grasped_description: Grasp the middle of the arm to rotate the crank mechanism.
physics.reason: Thin metal rod is effectively solid.

parts.description: Thin teal-colored rod extending downwards from the housing.
parts.function: Lever arm for the user to rotate the internal fan.

parts.name: grip pin

physics.Basic_description: Small pin connecting the grip to the crank arm.
physics.Functional_description: Axle allowing the grip to rotate freely on the arm.
physics.reason: Small metal pin is solid.

parts.description: Small pin connecting the grip to the crank arm.
parts.function: Axle allowing the grip to rotate freely on the arm.

parts.name: rotating grip

physics.Basic_description: Dark brown/maroon cylindrical handle at the end of the crank arm.
physics.Functional_description: Handle for the user to hold and turn the crank.
physics.Grasped_description: Primary interaction point; grasp the cylinder to operate the blower.
physics.reason: Molded plastic handle is typically hollow to save material.

parts.description: Dark brown/maroon cylindrical handle at the end of the crank arm.
parts.function: Handle for the user to hold and turn the crank.

parts.name: drive shaft

physics.Basic_description: Internal vertical shaft connecting the crank to the fan (mostly hidden).
physics.Functional_description: Transmits rotation from the external crank to the internal fan.
physics.reason: Drive shafts are typically solid metal rods.

parts.description: Internal vertical shaft connecting the crank to the fan (mostly hidden).
parts.function: Transmits rotation from the external crank to the internal fan.

parts.name: drive collar

physics.Basic_description: Small collar on the drive shaft near the housing exit.
physics.Functional_description: Retains the shaft or acts as a bearing surface.
physics.reason: Small mechanical part likely solid.

parts.description: Small collar on the drive shaft near the housing exit.
parts.function: Retains the shaft or acts as a bearing surface.

parts.name: fan wheel

physics.Basic_description: Grey bladed rotor visible inside the housing in the left view.
physics.Functional_description: Spins to generate airflow when cranked.
physics.reason: Fan blades are thin but effectively solid structures for mass calc.

parts.description: Grey bladed rotor visible inside the housing in the left view.
parts.function: Spins to generate airflow when cranked.

physics.Functional_description: Connects fan blades to the drive shaft.
physics.reason: Central hub is typically solid plastic to handle torque.

parts.function: Connects fan blades to the drive shaft.

simulation.collision: CoACD convex decomposition of concave source collision meshes (relative tolerance 0.03–0.05)

collisionFilter.description: Self-contact excluded between directly connected rigid groups, including the fixed base; nonadjacent contacts retained

simulation.inertia: Source URDF link inertials; missing inertials use geometry-derived defaults (density 1000 kg/m³)
simulation.friction: Source URDF mu1 as sliding friction; torsional 0.005, rolling 0.0001
simulation.contact: MuJoCo soft contacts (solref 0.01 1); source restitution is displayed, not converted
simulation.material: Rigid bodies; Young’s modulus and Poisson ratio are annotations, not soft-body parameters

interaction.description: Switchable virtual joint damping and reflected armature for interactive inspection; source properties are unchanged.
interaction.rule: damping ≥ rated effort / rated speed; armature = 2% child subtree mass (slide) or 2% mass × collision radius² (hinge)
